name: Tiny VGA
pins: uo[0..7] = R1 G1 B1 vsync R0 G0 B0 hsync

name: TT Audio
pins: audio on uo[7] or uio[7]; stereo on [6] and [7]

name: QSPI Flash/PSRAM
pins: uio[0..7] = CS0 SD0 SD1 SCK SD2 SD3 CS1 CS2

name: Gamepad
pins: ui[4] latch, ui[5] clock, ui[6] data

name: SPI Pmod
pins: uio[0..3] or uio[4..7] = CS MOSI MISO SCK

name: UART Pmod
pins: uio[1] TXD, uio[2] RXD (or uio[5], uio[6])

name: I2C Pmod
pins: uio[2] SCL, uio[3] SDA (or uio[6], uio[7])

name: UART over demo board USB
pins: ui[3] RX + uo[4] TX, or ui[1] RX + uo[0] TX
